verses.text: Ix sk'anb'anek' winhaj rey David chi' tato ayto junokxo yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ixto kani, yik syak'an swach'k'olal winh t'ay yuj swach'k'olal winhaj Jonatán yak'nak t'a winh.

Ay jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl skuch Siba, ix awtajkot winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey David chi'. Haxo yik ix jawi winh, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Siba? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', a in ton mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Manhxa am wal junok yinhtilal winhaj Saúl ayeq'ui, yik tzin ch'ox in wach'k'olal t'ay icha ix wutej wak'an in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi': --Aytokan jun winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán, chuklaj yok winh schab'il, xchi winh.
--¿B'ajtil ay winh? xchi winhaj David chi'. --Ha t'a spat winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Amiel t'a Lodebar, hata' ayek' winh, xchi winhaj Siba chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to b'at ik'jikot winhaj Mefi-boset yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi' winh yixchikin winhaj Saúl chi'. Ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Mefi-boset, xchi winh. --Tik ayin mamin rey, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, wach' ol wutej in b'a t'ayach yuj b'aj xajan yilnak in winhaj Jonatán winh a mam. Ol wak'xikan masanil lum sluum winh a mam icham aj Saúl t'ayach. Ol ach wanhej wet' t'a in mexa, xchi winh.
Ix em nhojan winhaj Mefi-boset chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tz'ok' a k'ol t'ayin? Ha in a chekab' in tik lajan in icha junok nok' chamnak tz'i', xchi winh.

Ix awtajxi winhaj Siba yuj winh rey chi', haton winh schekab'kan winhaj Saúl, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Tik wal swak'xikan masanil tastak yik winh a patrón yet' yuninal t'a winh yixchikin winh tik.

Ha ach tik yet' masanil heb' uninal yet' masanil heb' a chekab', ol ex munlaj t'a sat lum sluum winh chi'. Masanil tas ol el t'a sat lu'um, tza molb'ej t'a yol junok spatil, yik wach' tz'och yopisio yuj heb' yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset tik, palta haxo winh jun, ol wanhej winh wet'ok, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh. Olajunhwanh yuninal winhaj Siba chi', 20 heb' schekab' winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Siba chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas tza chek in k'ulej tik, ol in k'anab'ajej, xchi winh. Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', junjun k'u swa winh yet' winh rey chi', icha wal yuninal winh ix yutej winh.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yuneto skuchan Micaía. Masanil mach ayek' t'a spat winhaj Siba chi', schekab' winhaj Mefi-boset chi' yaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Mefi-boset chi', chuklaj yok winh schab'il, ha t'a Jerusalén ayek' winh yujto hata' swa winh yet' winhaj rey David chi'.
